matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: SSD300 reaches around 74 mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 test at roughly 59 FPS on a Titan X GPU, surpassing YOLO at higher speed.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: SSD300 achieves 74.3% mAP on VOC2007 test at 59 FPS on a Nvidia Titan X.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: SSD predicts category scores and bounding-box offsets relative to a set of default boxes per feature-map location, evaluated across multiple scales of feature maps.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: SSD uses a small convolutional filter to predict object categories and offsets in bounding box locations.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Predicting from feature maps at several different resolutions is critical for handling objects of different sizes within a single forward pass.
